Ali ibn Muhammad Rozhbin was a Persian scholar and historian who wrote extensively on the history of the Islamic world during the Timurid and Mongol periods. His most famous work is 'Jami' al-Tawarikh' which contains detailed accounts of the history of the Islamic world from the Prophet Muhammad's time up until the time of the author.
